# DoCo and the Pattern Ontology

`doco-2026-10-05.ttl` (DoCo, the Document Components Ontology, <http://purl.org/spar/doco>) and
`po-2026-10-05.ttl` (the Pattern Ontology, <http://purl.org/spar/po>) are unmodified snapshots of the
SPAR ontologies as published on 2026-10-05, kept for reference: `ontology/components/blocks.ttl`
builds its block types on their classes and properties. Their authors are named in each file
(`dc:creator`): Alexandru Constantin, Angelo Di Iorio, Silvio Peroni, Steve Pettifer, David Shotton
and Fabio Vitali.

(<https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode>), as each file states (`dcterms:license`).
